blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine women’s gymnastics squad qualified only for the team event medal round of the Asian Games on Tuesday at Nagoya General Gymnasium. None of the Philippine gymnasts qualified for an individual apparatus final, but the team advanced to the final as the seventh-place finisher with 144.563 points. Eight of the nine teams advanced. Levi Ruivivar came closest to an individual final, finishing 12th on uneven bars with 13.166 points to become the first reserve. Ruivivar also placed as a second reserve for the floor exercise […]...
